hana: quick note  we did a tiny canary for schedule-prefetch + compact-encode on a ded pool this AM. short results: p50 -21%, p95 -6%, p99 flat, token cost -28%.

jules: nice! bench paste?

hana: bench (pool: gd-dedicated-small, model: rw-7b-econ):

BEFORE: p50=76ms p95=215ms p99=330ms tps=920 cost=$0.0122/1k
AFTER: p50=60ms p95=202ms p99=333ms tps=1150 cost=$0.00878/1k
Delta: p50 -21.1% p95 -6.0% throughput +25% cost -28.0%

peter: any tails or quality issues?

hana: p99 ~same; tiny jitter during long >3k seqs. quality checks on eval set B show <0.4% metric drift. plan: gate compact-encode for seq_len>3200.

ci-bot: canary health: all checks green, error-rate down.

ops-bot: created INF-5088 "Console: surface schedule-prefetch savings per-route" assigned to peter. https://rwinf.atlassian.net/browse/INF-5088

jules: rollout plan?

hana: expand to 30% tonight, 70% tomorrow AM if stable, full GA after 12h. rollback via flag toggle: schedule_prefetch.enabled=false.

peter: adding p95 + seq_len alerts (10min window) and dashboard panel. dashboard: https://dashboards.redwood.ai/canaries/schedule-prefetch-3260000123

jules: great outcome  low risk and measurable savings. will draft a short blurb for #releases after 70%. :tada:
